combo_label: At the Supermarket × At the Funfair × Ancient Egypt

entries.clue: Last Ptolemaic ruler, lover of two Roman leaders
Cord round the neck of everyone working the store floor, name card dangling
Heretic king who exalted the sun-disc above all other gods
Missile thrown at playing cards to win a giant teddy
Booked window of time in which the grocery van should arrive
Living god who wore the double crown of two lands
Resting place cut for eternity in the Valley of the Kings
Funhouse fixture that stretches and squashes your reflection
Wooden-headed basher for croquet, or for ringing the strength-test bell
Scribbled before you leave home, then ticked off item by item
Basil or mint, dried in a jar down one row or growing in a pot by the salads
Substitute the picker sends when your first choice was not on the van
Hairy target you try to knock off its stand at a classic shy
